answer: Attention Tide with Nebula Probes: task priority is an EWMA of timely, correct replies to unpredictable whisper probes drawn from a private nebula of each agent’s recent task context; probes require state-dependent answers mid-work. New identities start at low tide, and only sustained accurate attention raises it. A sybil attacker must divide attention across N identities: either fund N concurrent attentive operators/agents, forgoing productive work, or let scores decay and lose high-value allocation. Cost scales linearly with identity count.
